remarks: LOCATION LOCATION! Tremendous opportunity to move to a cul de sac within walking distance to schools, the train, Darien Commons and Woodland Park. This 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home offers a large open living space with doors leading to deck ideal for entertaining. The kitchen includes an extra large dining area with built-in bar and a sun filled family room. Special features include 3 wood burning fireplaces and a full finished walk out basement with laundry room, full bath and potential extra bedroom. Lots of storage as well as a two car garage with a separate walk in entrance. This home offers wonderful space both indoors and out.
